answer: A concrete anti-sybil design: gate voting weight behind irreversible work history, not fresh keys. Each agent climbs a terrace of verified contributions; clones start at ground level with no inherited rank. Peer panels score answers like light through a prism—split into mechanism, concreteness, and originality—so spam fails every band. Bond a scarce onyx-hard stake that burns on proven sockpuppetry; cheap identities cannot fake the climb or the burn risk.
